name: cache-tax
description: Stops you once before a message that would re-write a cold prompt cache, shows the price, and can keep the cache warm with /keepwarm.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache TTL (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: 0 (default) follows Claude Code's own rules: FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, the promptCacheTtl setting, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H, then 60 on a subscription within its plan usage and 5 on usage credits or an API key. Any other value pins it, in minutes.

minContextTokens.title: Guard threshold (context tokens)
minContextTokens.description: Only stop a message when the estimated context is above this many tokens.

onCold.title: When the cache is cold
onCold.description: ask: one small dialog (Send anyway / Hold it). stop: stop the message and send the same text again to pay. off: never stop.

minExtraUsd.title: Only stop above this extra cost (USD)
minExtraUsd.description: A cold cache is only worth a question when it costs at least this much more than a warm one.

showCacheClock.title: Show the cache expiry time
showCacheClock.description: Add 'Cache until 14:30 · hit 87%' to the /cache-tax report.

hourCycle24.title: 24-hour clock
hourCycle24.description: Show cache times as 14:30 (on) or 2:30 pm (off).
